_comment: Feeder-series rising-stars watchlist, powering /information/feeder-series/up-and-coming-drivers-to-watch. DRAFTED FROM WEB RESEARCH by an agent (2026-07-07) with per-driver sources + confidence, but NOT editor-fact-checked — the watchlist page ships review:'unverified' (noindex, excluded from search) until reviewed. UPDATE CADENCE: refresh after each F2/F3 title decider and at season start; prune drivers who reach F1 and add new champions. `confidence` is the agent's self-assessment. — 2026-07-08: all entries fact-checked (3-lens audit) and the watchlist promoted review:'verified' + featured (aggressive index round).

drivers.name: Leonardo Fornaroli
highlights: 2025 FIA Formula 2 champion as a rookie with Invicta Racing
2024 FIA Formula 3 champion
Named a McLaren F1 reserve and test driver for 2026
drivers.why: Only the fifth driver ever to win the F3 then F2 title in consecutive seasons, and now inside McLaren's F1 setup.

drivers.name: Jak Crawford
highlights: Runner-up in the 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship
Multiple F2 feature-race wins across 2024-2025
Named Aston Martin F1 third driver for 2026
drivers.why: America's leading single-seater talent, stepping into an F1 third-driver role with Aston Martin.

drivers.name: Luke Browning
highlights: Fourth in the 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship
Williams Driver Academy member since 2023
Named Williams F1 reserve driver for 2026
drivers.why: Williams academy graduate and 2026 F1 reserve who took multiple F2 wins in 2025.

drivers.name: Alex Dunne
highlights: Fifth in the 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship as a rookie, with two feature-race wins
Made an F1 free-practice appearance with McLaren in 2025
Joined the Alpine Academy for 2026 (ex-McLaren junior)
drivers.why: Ireland's brightest single-seater prospect, backed by Alpine after a standout rookie F2 campaign.

drivers.name: Arvid Lindblad
highlights: Sixth in the 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship as a rookie
Promoted to Formula 1 with Racing Bulls for 2026
20th Red Bull junior to reach Formula 1
drivers.why: Red Bull's newest F1 graduate, stepping up to Racing Bulls at 18 after an impressive rookie F2 year.

drivers.name: Dino Beganovic
highlights: 2022 Formula Regional European champion
Long-standing Ferrari Driver Academy member with Ferrari F1 test outings
Second full F2 season in 2026, moving to DAMS Lucas Oil
drivers.why: Established Ferrari junior entering his second F2 season as a genuine title outsider.

drivers.name: Rafael Câmara
highlights: 2025 FIA Formula 3 champion as a rookie with Trident
Ferrari Driver Academy member
Steps up to F2 in 2026 with reigning champions Invicta Racing
drivers.why: Reigning F3 champion joining F2's dominant team, tipped for a possible third straight Invicta rookie title.

drivers.name: Nikola Tsolov
highlights: Runner-up (2nd) in the 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship
Maiden F2 podium in the 2025 Abu Dhabi sprint race
Red Bull junior stepping up to a full F2 season in 2026 with Campos
drivers.why: Record-setting F3 race-winner and Red Bull junior graduating to Formula 2.

drivers.name: Gabriele Minì
highlights: Alpine Academy member since 2023
Several F2 wins and podiums since 2024
Continues in F2 for 2026 with MP Motorsport
drivers.why: Experienced Alpine junior whom the team has openly tasked with fighting for the 2026 F2 title.

drivers.name: Mari Boya
highlights: Third in the 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship with Campos
First driver signed to the Aston Martin driver academy (2025)
Graduates to F2 in 2026 with Prema Racing
drivers.why: Spanish F3 front-runner and inaugural Aston Martin academy signing stepping up to F2.

drivers.name: Paul Aron
highlights: Competed at the front of the 2024 FIA Formula 2 Championship
Alpine Academy member and the team's main F1 reserve driver
Holds the superlicence points required to race in Formula 1
drivers.why: F1-ready Estonian serving as Alpine's reserve while awaiting a grid opening.

drivers.name: Martinius Stenshorne
highlights: Fifth in the 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship with two wins
2023 Formula Regional European runner-up
Full F2 rookie season in 2026 with Rodin Motorsport (former McLaren junior)
drivers.why: Fast Norwegian who has openly targeted the F2 title in his rookie season.

drivers.name: Sebastián Montoya
highlights: Son of two-time Indy 500 winner Juan Pablo Montoya
Scored podiums in FIA Formula 3 before graduating to F2
Continues in F2 for 2026 with Prema Racing
drivers.why: Second-generation talent building his craft in F2 with a leading team.

drivers.name: Tuukka Taponen
highlights: Ferrari Driver Academy member since 2023
2024 Formula Regional Middle East champion
Three F3 podiums in 2025; continues in F3 for 2026 with MP Motorsport
drivers.why: Ferrari's leading F3 junior and a highly rated long-term academy prospect.

drivers.name: Ugo Ugochukwu
highlights: McLaren junior from 2021-2025 with multiple junior titles
Two F3 sprint podiums in 2025 with Prema
Leading the 2026 FIA F3 Championship early with Campos
drivers.why: Long-touted American who has found form as an early 2026 F3 title leader after leaving McLaren.

drivers.name: James Wharton
highlights: Maiden F3 win in the 2025 Spielberg sprint race
F2 debut with Trident in the 2025 Qatar round
Returns to Prema for a second F3 season in 2026 (former Ferrari junior)
drivers.why: Race-winning Australian with clear single-seater speed and top-team backing.

drivers.name: Fionn McLaughlin
highlights: 2025 British F4 champion in his rookie car season, with the Rookie Cup
Red Bull Junior Team member since 2024
Jumps straight to FIA F3 for 2026 with Hitech, skipping Formula Regional
drivers.why: Red Bull junior from Northern Ireland making an aggressive leap from F4 champion to F3.

drivers.name: Alessandro Giusti
highlights: 2022 French F4 champion
Tenth in the 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship
Williams Driver Academy member
drivers.why: Williams junior and consistent F3 points-scorer on an upward trajectory.

drivers.name: Freddie Slater
highlights: 2025 Formula Regional European champion with Prema
2024 Italian F4 and F4 UAE champion
First member of the Audi driver development programme; F3 in 2026 with Trident
drivers.why: Serial junior champion and Audi's first F1-project junior, a favourite for the 2026 F3 title.

drivers.name: Matteo De Palo
highlights: Runner-up in the 2025 Formula Regional European Championship
Joined the McLaren driver development programme in late 2025
Steps up to FIA F3 for 2026 with Trident
drivers.why: Italian regional-formula front-runner freshly added to McLaren's stable and moving into F3.

drivers.name: Kean Nakamura-Berta
highlights: 2025 Italian F4 champion with Prema Racing
Williams Driver Academy member (formerly an Alpine junior)
Graduates to Formula Regional for 2026
drivers.why: Dominant national-F4 champion now on Williams' books and climbing the regional ladder.

drivers.name: Rashid Al Dhaheri
highlights: Mercedes junior programme member
Runner-up in Formula Regional Middle East 2026
Racing in the Formula Regional European Championship in 2026
drivers.why: Emirati karting prodigy on Mercedes' programme progressing steadily through the regional formulae.

drivers.name: Christian Costoya
highlights: McLaren driver development programme member
Multiple international karting titles
Graduates to F4 in 2026 (Italian F4, Euro 4 and F4 Middle East)
drivers.why: Highly rated karting graduate stepping into car racing under McLaren's wing.

drivers.name: Dries Van Langendonck
highlights: McLaren driver development programme member
2026 Formula Winter Series champion
Full British F4 campaign in 2026
drivers.why: Belgian McLaren junior transitioning from karting with early single-seater silverware.

drivers.name: Ethan Jeff-Hall
highlights: 2024 FIA Karting OK world champion
Mercedes junior programme member
Fifth in the 2025 British F4 Championship with a win; continues in 2026
drivers.why: World-champion karter and Mercedes junior making his mark in British F4.

drivers.name: Kenzo Craigie
highlights: 2024 FIA Karting OK-Junior world champion
Mercedes junior programme member
Steps up to Italian F4 and Euro 4 for 2026
drivers.why: Another world-title karter in Mercedes' pipeline moving into single-seaters.

drivers.name: Salim Hanna
highlights: 2025 Italian F4 Rookie champion with Prema Racing
Fourth overall in the 2025 Italian F4 Championship
drivers.why: Colombian rookie who topped the newcomers in a strong Prema line-up.

drivers.name: Thomas Strauven
highlights: 2025 F4 Spanish champion with Campos, clinched with five races to spare
2025 Eurocup-4 winter champion
drivers.why: Belgian who swept a Spanish F4 and Eurocup-4 double in a dominant 2025.

drivers.name: Enzo Deligny
highlights: Third overall in the 2025 Formula Regional European Championship
Continues in Formula Regional for 2026 with Prema Racing
drivers.why: French regional-formula podium regular worth tracking as he matures.

drivers.name: Noah Baglin
highlights: 2025 FIA Karting OK-Junior world champion
Ferrari Driver Academy member
Continues in karting for 2026
drivers.why: Reigning junior world karting champion and Ferrari's newest karting recruit.

drivers.name: Thibaut Ramaekers
highlights: 2025 FIA Karting World champion in the senior OK category
First Belgian OK world champion in 50 years
drivers.why: Senior world karting champion widely expected to graduate to single-seaters.

drivers.name: Filippo Sala
highlights: Ferrari Driver Academy member (joined 2025)
Multiple international karting titles
Races in KZ2 gearbox karting in 2026
drivers.why: Italian Ferrari junior and karting standout being developed by the academy.

drivers.name: Scott Lindblom
highlights: Joined the Red Bull Junior Team via the 2024 driver search
Leading karting talent still too young for FIA F4 in 2025
drivers.why: Young Swedish Red Bull junior earmarked as a long-term prospect.

drivers.name: Chiara Bättig
highlights: Swiss karting champion
Added to the Red Bull Junior Team in 2025
drivers.why: One of the few female drivers on Red Bull's junior roster, rising through karting.

drivers.name: Harry Williams
highlights: McLaren's youngest-ever development signing (age 11, in 2026)
Race-winning British karter
drivers.why: An unusually early McLaren signing being developed from the karting grassroots up.

drivers.name: Dean Hoogendoorn
highlights: 2025 FIA Karting European Junior champion
WSK Super Master Series OK-Junior champion
Williams Driver Academy member
drivers.why: Dutch karting title-winner recruited into the Williams academy.

drivers.name: Doriane Pin
highlights: 2025 F1 Academy champion with Prema
Named a Mercedes F1 development driver for 2026
Race-winning sportscar experience with Iron Dames
drivers.why: The dominant F1 Academy champion and Mercedes' most advanced female prospect.

drivers.name: Alba Larsen
highlights: Ferrari Driver Academy member (joined 2025)
Ferrari's F1 Academy entry for 2026 with MP Motorsport
drivers.why: Danish talent chosen as Ferrari's female single-seater project for 2026.

drivers.name: Ella Lloyd
highlights: McLaren-supported F1 Academy driver
Welsh racer competing in the all-female series
drivers.why: McLaren's F1 Academy representative and one of Britain's leading female juniors.

drivers.name: Nina Gademan
highlights: Alpine-backed F1 Academy driver
Maiden F1 Academy win at Zandvoort in 2025
Sixth in the 2025 F1 Academy standings
drivers.why: Dutch Alpine junior who took a home win in F1 Academy and returns for 2026.

drivers.name: Dennis Hauger
highlights: 2025 Indy NXT champion and Rookie of the Year with Andretti (six wins)
2021 FIA Formula 3 champion
Promoted to the NTT IndyCar Series for 2026 with Dale Coyne Racing
drivers.why: Former F3 champion who dominated Indy NXT and steps up to IndyCar in 2026.

drivers.name: Lochie Hughes
highlights: Third in the 2025 Indy NXT Championship with Andretti Global
drivers.why: Australian Andretti driver among the front-runners on the US single-seater ladder.

drivers.name: Caio Collet
highlights: Runner-up in the 2025 Indy NXT Championship
2024 Indy NXT Rookie of the Year
Multiple Indy NXT race wins
drivers.why: Brazilian former Alpine junior now a consistent Indy NXT title contender.

drivers.name: Connor Zilisch
highlights: Ten wins and Rookie of the Year in the 2025 NASCAR Xfinity Series
Runner-up in the 2025 Xfinity championship
2025 NMPA Driver of the Year; steps up to NASCAR Cup for 2026 with Trackhouse
drivers.why: Widely called NASCAR's brightest prospect in a generation, promoted straight to Cup for 2026.

drivers.name: Corey Heim
highlights: 2025 NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series champion
A single-season record 12 Truck wins in 2025
Toyota development driver with select Cup starts lined up
drivers.why: The most dominant driver in the Truck Series, primed for a full NASCAR Cup step.

drivers.name: William Sawalich
highlights: Two-time ARCA Menards Series East champion (2023, 2024)
Toyota development driver with Joe Gibbs Racing
Full-time NASCAR Xfinity rookie in 2025 with two runner-up finishes
drivers.why: Toyota's headline stock-car prospect learning the Xfinity ranks at Joe Gibbs Racing.

drivers.name: Mille Johansson
highlights: 2025 Junior WRC champion, clinched on the final round
Earns an M-Sport Ford Fiesta Rally2 prize drive package for 2026
drivers.why: Swedish rally junior who won the FIA's junior WRC title and its step-up prize.

drivers.name: Noah Strømsted
highlights: Sixth overall in the 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship
drivers.why: Consistent Danish F3 front-runner and one to watch as he targets a move up.
